## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
library(here)       # to get R project path
library(fs)         # for file path manipulation
library(openxlsx) 　# for exporting to excel
library(survey)       # for survey design


# 各種の関数セット読み込み
source("../myTools.R")  # プロジェクトルートから読み込む（quarto限定の処理）

# 対象とする年のリスト
yearlist <- c("2005", "2006", "2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011",
"2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")
# yearlist <- c("2005", "2006")
yearlist <- c("2005")

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# データベース一覧
endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

# 変数ラベル一覧
endes_var_labels <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_var_labels.rds"))

# ファイル名の設定
files <- c("BRdata-rh","IRdata-rh","IRdata-rc","IRdata-nt","KRvac","KRdata",
           "KRiycf-nt","WASHdata-ws","IRdata-ms","KRstool", "PRdata", "HRdata-dm")

# RDSファイルを読み込む関数
# year: 年
# filename: ファイル名（拡張子なし）
# select_col: 抽出する列名のベクトル（NULLの場合は全列を抽出）
open_processed_file <- function(year, filename, select_col = NULL) {
  file_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year, paste0(filename, ".RDS")) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
    if (file_exists(file_path)) {
      df <- readRDS(file_path) %>%
        rename_with(~ tolower(.x))
    if (!is.null(select_col)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(select_col))
    }
    # merge_key設定：HRdata-dmのみ結合キーが"hhid"
    if (filename == "WASHdata-ws") {
      merge_key <- c("hhid")
    } else {
      merge_key <- c("caseid")
    }
    
    print("重複チェック")
    if (duplicate_check(df, merge_key, filename) == 0) {
      duplicate_check_detail(df, merge_key, filename)
    }
    return(df)
  } else {
    stop("File does not exist: ", file_path)
  }
}

# open_processed_file関数内で、またはデータ読み込み直後に実施
open_processed_file_normalized <- function(year, filename) {
  data <- open_processed_file(year, filename)
  
  # データフレームとして確実に変換
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    data <- as.data.frame(data)
  }
  
  # 列名の正規化
  names(data) <- names(data) %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "_") %>%
    tolower()  # 小文字に統一（オプション）
  
  return(data)
}


```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}
# 必要なデータセットの抽出

# ******************************************************************************
# 関数定義：年ごとにデータを結合
# @title goAnalysis
# @param year 処理対象の年
# @return 結合されたデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
goAnalysis <- function(year){
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ結合処理開始:", year, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")

  print(paste("Processing year:", year))
  # 出力用のルートフォルダを指定
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
  # 出力用のルートフォルダが存在しない場合は作成
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  # 必要なデータセットの抽出
  print("必要なデータセットを抽出します")
  
  keep_RECH1 <- c("HV001", "HV002", "HV103", "HHID", "HVIDX")
  keep_RECH6 <- c("HC1", "hc27", "HC56", "HC70", "HC71", "HC72", "HHID", "HC0")
  data_all <- list()
  data_merged <- NULL
  
  for (f in files){
    print(paste("Loading file:", f))
    data_all[[f]] <- open_processed_file_normalized(year, f)
  }
  
  data_merged <- data_all[["BRdata-rh"]]
  
  print("(2) Merging with IRdata-rh")
  data_all[["IRdata-rh"]] <- data_all[["IRdata-rh"]] %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(age, wt))
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-rh"]], by = c("caseid"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(3) Merging with IRdata-rc")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-rc"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(4) Merging with IRdata-nt")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-nt"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(5) Merging with KRvac")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRvac"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "age", "wt", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(6) Merging with KRdata")
  data_all[["KRdata"]] <- data_all[["KRdata"]] %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(age, wt))
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRdata"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(7) Merging with KRiycf-nt")
  data_all[["KRiycf-nt"]] <- data_all[["KRiycf-nt"]] %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c("b4", "v005", "v022", "v025", "v106", "v190", "age"))
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRiycf-nt"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(8) Merging with IRdata-ms")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-ms"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(9) Merging with KRstool")
  data_all[["KRstool"]] <- data_all[["KRstool"]] %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(age, wt))
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRstool"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("(10) Merging with HRdata-dm")
  data_all[["HRdata-dm"]] <- data_all[["HRdata-dm"]] %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(v005, v022)) %>%
    mutate(
      v001 = unclass(v001),
      v002 = unclass(v002)
    )
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["HRdata-dm"]], by = c("v001", "v002", "year")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
    rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
    
  print("(11) Merging with WASHdata-ws")
 if (year == "2005") {
  cat("=== 2005年のWASHデータマージ処理開始 ===\n")
   
  # HRdata-dmからhhidキーを抽出
  # 1. まずデータ構造を確認
  hr_data <- data_all[["HRdata-dm"]]

  # 2. 列名の正規化（前後スペース除去＋特殊文字対応）
  # names(hr_data) <- names(hr_data) %>%
  #   str_squish() %>%
  #   str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "_")  # スペースをアンダースコアに統一
  
  # 3. 正規化後の列名を確認
  # cat("正規化後の列名:\n")
  # cat(names(hr_data), "\n")
  
  # 4. caseid列の存在確認
  if (!"caseid" %in% names(hr_data)) {
    stop("caseid列が見つかりません。正規化後の列名を確認してください。")
  }
   
    hr_hhid_clean <- hr_data %>%
    select(caseid, hhid) %>%
    mutate(
      caseid_key = paste(map_chr(str_split(str_squish(caseid), " "), 1),
                         map_chr(str_split(str_squish(caseid), " "), 2),
                         sep = " "),
      hhid_normalized = str_squish(hhid)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(hhid)) %>%
    select(caseid_key, hhid_normalized) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # data_mergedの既存hhidを削除してから、新しいhhidを追加
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    select(-any_of("hhid")) %>%  # ← 既存のhhidを削除
    mutate(
      caseid_key = paste(map_chr(str_split(str_squish(caseid), " "), 1),
                         map_chr(str_split(str_squish(caseid), " "), 2),
                         sep = " ")
    ) %>%
    left_join(hr_hhid_clean, by = "caseid_key", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    rename(hhid = hhid_normalized) %>%
    select(-caseid_key)
  
  # WASH merge
  data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] <- data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] %>%
    select(-any_of(c("hhid_clean")))
  
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    mutate(hhid_normalized = str_squish(hhid))
  
  data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] <- data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] %>%
    mutate(hhid_normalized = str_squish(hhid))
  
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] %>% select(-hhid),
    by = c("hhid_normalized"))
  
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    select(-any_of(c("hhid_clean", "hhid_normalized"))) %>%
    rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x"))
  
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  cat("=== WASH merge completed for year 2005 ===\n")
  cat("Final rows:", nrow(data_merged), "\n")
  
  } else {
    data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
      data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]], by = c("hhid"))
    if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
      stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
    }
  }

  print("(12) Merging with PRdata")
  # 2005/2006のデータが特殊なため、キーを正規化してマージする
  # 正規化済みキーを新しい列として作成
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    mutate(
      caseid_trim = str_trim(caseid),
      hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
      year_trim = str_trim(year)
    )
  
  data_all[["PRdata"]] <- data_all[["PRdata"]] %>%
    mutate(
      caseid_trim = str_trim(caseid),
      hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
      year_trim = str_trim(year)
    )

  # 正規化済みキーを使用してマージ
  print("(12) Merging with PRdata using normalized keys")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["PRdata"]], 
    by = c("caseid_trim", "hhid_trim", "year_trim")) %>%
    filter(age >= 6 & age <= 24) %>%
    select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
    rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x"))

  print("子供の月齢6ヶ月から24ヶ月で絞り込みました")
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }

  # 元のキー列（caseid, hhid, year）のみを残す
  # 正規化キー列（caseid_trim, hhid_trim, year_trim）は削除
  data_merged <- data_merged %>%
    select(-caseid_trim, -hhid_trim, -year_trim)    
  
  print("データセットの抽出と結合が完了しました")

  # ============================================================================
  # 保存
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 7. ファイル保存\n")
  saveRDS(data_merged, paste0(output_dir, "/data_merged.rds"))
  cat("全データ結合完了:", year, "\n")
  
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("処理完了:", year, ": データ数", nrow(data_merged), "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n")

  
    
  # return(data_all) # デバッグ用
  return(data_merged)
}

```

## 3. ループ実行

```{r}
#** ここから実行
mydata <- list()
for (yr in yearlist) {
  mydata[[yr]] <- goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
